name: apple-video-kit
description: Apple-style motion templates, transitions and a screen-share stage for HyperFrames videos.

scripts.check:all: npm run -s media && npm run -s check && npm run -s check:face && npm run -s share:check && npm run -s check:privacy
scripts.library: npm run -s media && npm run -s build:library && node scripts/serve.mjs 4173
scripts.share:check: node scripts/sync-share.mjs && node scripts/check-face-clear.mjs projects/screen-share/index.html && hyperframes check projects/screen-share
